correction_reason: Advance Horo Lite baseline from Phase E (TICKET-HLITE-005) to Phase J (TICKET-HLITE-010) recording complete Phase A through Phase I test consolidation (19/19 unified reading PASS, zero regressions across test suites).
rationale: Record verified test provenance baseline for Horo Lite Phase J (TICKET-HLITE-010) consolidating complete Phase A through Phase I test coverage in tests/test_horo_lite_unified_reading.py: 1) Phase A: Versioned Pydantic v2 schemas and validation for UnifiedReadingRequest, TopicModule, MonthlyScoreItem, PastPatternCandidate, and UnifiedReadingResponse. 2) Phase B: Deterministic 12-month annual timing engine with score bounds [1..10], traceable monthly reasons, and 3-5 non-sensitive past pattern candidate generation with child boundary calibration. 3) Phase C: Multi-tradition consensus matrix arbitration across Thai Suriyayart and BaZi cycles with fail-closed HITL queue routing (<0.75 consensus or unknown hour). 4) Phase D: POST /api/v3/unified-reading FastAPI endpoint contract, deterministic latency SLA (<300ms), translation SLA (<2.5s), and strict score/fact immutability by LLM. 5) Phase E: Clean single-column form DOM contract with 1:1 accessible label binding, collapsed advanced disclosure, and single primary action button. 6) Phase F: 12 modular canonical topic presentation in exact CANONICAL_TOPIC_IDS sequence with collapsible technical basis and fail-closed labeled fallback policy. 7) Phase G: Interactive feedback UI for past pattern calibration with 4 feedback choices, role=group, consent-checkbox strictly guarded localStorage persistence, and zero false accuracy metrics. 8) Phase H: Multi-format client-side canvas rasterizer supporting Full vertical PNG, 1080x1920 Story PNG, copy social summary with privacy masking default, and print/PDF. 9) Phase I: WCAG AA contrast compliance, visible focus rings, full keyboard tab order and Enter/Space activation, ARIA landmarks, non-destructive retry recovery, and unknown-hour notice ergonomics. Verification: 19/19 PASS in tests/test_horo_lite_unified_reading.py, 19/19 PASS in regression test suites (test_visual_endpoints.py, test_browser_notifications_and_processing_modal.py, test_bazi_resilient_fallback.py), zero regressions.
